listing.name: God of War III Remastered (gow3_pc)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for gow3_pc; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream port/features and supported CUSA/version pairs. Experimental Linux/GPU limits remain; no independent full playthrough here. Fork parent bloodborne is framework ancestry, different game. Windows/Linux experimental glibc2.39 AVX/Vulkan1.3 package; not original PS3 GodOfWarIII data. Upstream platforms: Windows10/11; experimental Linux x86-64 glibc2.39+, AVX, Vulkan1.3. PS4 edition, not original PS3 game. Original data: PS4 GodOfWarIIIRemastered CUSA01623/CUSA01715 v01.00/01.02 own dump. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
